name: rill
description: Software you deploy and manage in your own Cloudflare account.

RILL_DATA_KEY.description: Encrypts saved add-on keys. Run `openssl rand -base64 32` in Terminal and paste the result. **Save a copy**: if it changes, saved keys stop working.

RILL_SETUP_TOKEN.description: A one-time code you type on first sign-in to claim this install. Run `openssl rand -hex 16`, paste it here, and keep it for the first-run page.
